sentences.text: As per the demand made by accused, CW 2 and CW3 have given Rs.Five lakhs cash, gold and silver ornaments to accused and Rs.10 lakhs worth gold ornaments to CW-1.

After the marriage, CW-1 started residing with accused at No.160, 2nd cross,
4th Main road, CT Bed, Thyagarajanagar, at that time, the accused was not doing any job and harassing complainant in demand of more dowry and accused subjected CW-1 to cruelty both physically and mentally.
Based on the said information, a case in Cr.No.392/2017 came to be registered against the accused for the aforesaid offences.
3. After completion of the investigation, the P.S.I of Basavanagudi Women P.S. has filed chargesheet against accused for the aforesaid offences.
On receipt of charge sheet, this court took cognizance of the alleged offences.
Pursuant to the issuance and service of summons, accused entered appearance and was  3  C.C.No.10580/2018 enlarged on bail.

The plea of the accused was recorded.

6. Heard arguments on both the sides.
I have Perused the materials on record.

7. The following points arise for my determination:-
 1) Whether the prosecution proves beyond all reasonable  doubt that the accused person caused physical and  mental cruelty to the complainant in demand of dowry  and thereby accused has committed the offences  punishable U/s.498A of IPC. & Sec.3 & 4 of D.P. Act.?
 4  C.C.No.10580/2018  2) what order?
 8. My finding to the above points are as under:-
 Point No.1 ........In the Negative.
 Point No.2........

As per final order, for the following:
 REASONS  9. POINT No.1 :- It is the fundamental principle of criminal jurisprudence that the prosecution has to prove its case beyond reasonable doubt.

In order to bring home the guilt of the accused,
the prosecution has examined one witness as PW-1 got marked Ex.P.1 and Ex.P2 documents.
Ex.P1 is the first information statement.
Ex.P.2 is the spot panchanama.
10. CW-1 was examined as PW-1 Smt. Shwetha.

She in her examination-in-chief has deposed that her marriage with accused No.1 was performed on 25-05-2014 and deposed after the Swetha Alias Swetha V Yadav vs Chetan on 1 February, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/165833513/
3 marriage, accused looked after her well and deposed accused did not subjected her to any physical and mental cruelty, in demand of dowry and never threatened to kill her.

sentences.text: PW-1 deposed that there was petty quarrel between her and accused in respect to family issues, for which she went to the police station.
There the police have took her signatures on documents.
PW-1 identified  5  C.C.No.10580/2018 Ex.P.1 first information statement and also identified her signature at Ex.P1.
PW-1 also identified Ex.P.2 spot Panchanama and her signature at Ex.P2 and she pleaded her ignorance about the contents of Ex.P.1 and P.2.
The learned Sr.APP treated PW-1 as hostile witness and cross examined her.
During which PW-1 admitted that she and accused have compromised the matter and denied all other suggestions.
11. On appreciation of entire materials on record, it is apparent that PW-1 being the informant, key and material witness have turned hostile to the prosecution case.
Therefore, this court was pleased to reject the prayer of the learned Sr.APP to summon other chargesheeted witnesses.

Even, if the summons was issued to other chargesheeted witnesses, no purpose would be served as the material witness has given go-bye to her own statement and also the valuable time of the court would be saved.
As such other charge sheeted witnesses were dropped and prosecution evidence was taken as closed.
In view of the material witness, turning hostile the prosecution has failed to bring home the guilt of the accused beyond reasonable doubt.

Accordingly, I answer Point No.1 in the Swetha Alias Swetha V Yadav vs Chetan on 1 February, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/165833513/
